descriptions: Fixed newly created female characters always spawning with the default male model in the creation menu; the creator now initializes its internal gender state (not just the ped model) so changing hair, face or clothes no longer reverts the character back to male
Added a startCharacter export and a { gender } option on the qf_skinmenu_v2:openCreationMenu event to pass the gender explicitly when opening the creator
Added automatic gender detection from the framework PlayerData (QBCore/Qbox charinfo.gender, ESX sex) when no gender is passed
Fixed the default skin being mutated by reference during creation
